subject.title: fix(update): repair plugin config during upgrade finalization

question: Does the finalization Doctor repair scope remain limited to configured plugin state when the post-core update marker permits the update resume through invalid-config validation?
rationale: This is an intentional compatibility change for existing upgrades; code and focused tests establish the marker plumbing, but maintainers must accept the resulting upgrade-time repair boundary.

options.title: Confirm and merge the scoped repair
options.body: Accept the update-only exception after verifying the completed configured-plugin upgrade acceptance run demonstrates that unrelated invalid configuration still stops normally.

options.title: Require a narrower repair assertion
options.body: Request an additional integration assertion if the acceptance evidence does not distinguish configured-plugin repair from other invalid-config states.

recommendation.title: Confirm and merge the scoped repair
recommendation.body: Accept the update-only exception after verifying the completed configured-plugin upgrade acceptance run demonstrates that unrelated invalid configuration still stops normally.

likelyOwner.reason: The assigned member authored the affected update-finalization implementation and can provide the most direct context for the intended repair boundary.
